workflow.ModelConfig.extra_body: every harness executor refuses a non-empty value; the field stays only because the step fingerprint hashes the whole ModelConfig

workflow.WorktreeSpec.node_modules_mode: how a worktree of a JavaScript repository gets node_modules (junction, install or none); references/ohflow.md documents it, and no ohflow concept rests on it
workflow.WorktreeSpec.node_modules_source: the node_modules folder a junction points at, the repository's own by default; a detail of node_modules_mode
workflow.WorktreeSpec.node_modules_sentinel: the file whose presence says node_modules is installed; a detail of node_modules_mode
workflow.WorktreeSpec.install_cmd: the install command a worktree runs when node_modules_mode is install; a detail of node_modules_mode
workflow.WorktreeSpec.reuse_existing: the engine sets it when a resumed run finds a worktree already at its path; a workflow leaves it false

workflow.AgentSpec.fork_session: a prior pi or Claude Code session the agent's conversation forks from; implement-review's fork_session argument fills it, and the concept is RetryPolicy.carry_context under retry

workflow.Step.pool: reserved and unused: no code reads it

workflow.Contracts.text: the text of the contracts file as the workflow read it; campaign contracts names the file

workflow.UnitPath.description: display text for a unit path in the CLI and the dashboard; it carries no behaviour

workflow.Phase.slug_override: replaces the slug in a phase's directory name in the run directory; a naming detail

campaign.MilestoneState.judgements: the controller's count of judge decisions, rebuilt from the campaign log by campaign.replay; internal state
campaign.MilestoneState.revisions: the controller's count of committed REVISE decisions, which the milestone revision budget spends; internal state rebuilt from the campaign log
campaign.MilestoneState.granted: the controller's sum of milestone revision grants, rebuilt from the campaign log; internal state
campaign.MilestoneState.run_dir: the run directory of the milestone's current round, rebuilt from the campaign log; internal state
campaign.MilestoneState.decisions: the judge decisions the controller rebuilt from the campaign log; internal state

cli flags: preflight.--verbose: a display option: also list the passed checks

cli flags: validate.--verbose: a display option: add the detail of every step

cli flags: run.--reservation-token: hidden: the run --detach launcher hands it to the supervisor it starts; no operator passes it

cli flags: watch.--poll: hidden: how often watch rereads the run, 2 s by default; the tests shorten it

cli flags: campaign watch.--poll: hidden: how often campaign watch rereads the campaign, 2 s by default; the tests shorten it

cli flags: table.--by: a display option: one row per run, phase or step
cli flags: table.--format: a display option: Markdown or JSON
cli flags: table.--reconcile: a diagnostic option: compare each agent result's tokens with the harness executor's usage records

cli flags: transcript.--html: a display option: export a pi session as HTML

cli flags: dashboard.--open: a display option of ohflow dashboard, which serves the page of an existing run directory: open it in the browser
cli flags: dashboard.--port: the port ohflow dashboard serves on, one the OS picks by default

cli flags: rollcall.--config: a JSON file of the model and params per harness executor for one roll call; an argument, no concept
cli flags: rollcall.--repo: the repository a roll call runs in, a throwaway one by default; an argument, no concept
cli flags: rollcall.--verbose: a display option: stream each run's own lines
